form.label: Process Finder
form.description: Find rare MD5/image-path combinations. Percentage is distinct hosts for that hash/path divided by hosts with MD5 in the selected image-path population and time range.

search.query: `sysmon` EventCode=1 MD5=* sysmon_process_path=$procsel|s$ | eventstats dc(sysmon_computer) AS total_host | stats dc(sysmon_computer) AS count earliest(_time) AS first_seen values(total_host) AS total_host by MD5 sysmon_process_path | eval majority_percent=round((count/total_host)*100,2) | where majority_percent < tonumber($ltpercent|s$) | sort 0 majority_percent MD5 sysmon_process_path | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p") | rename sysmon_process_path AS Image | table MD5 Image first_seen count majority_percent total_host
